title: Increased memory usage and memory leak in Traefik v3
body:
After upgrading to Traefik 3 (v3.0.3) I noticed it uses a lot more memory (`70 MB` vs `5 GB`) than v2 did. And it keeps increasing, indicating a possible memory leak.

![image](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/assets/1036439/c5973f42-5f97-4c68-a07b-5281a5c0285a)

Switching traefik container back to 2.11 fixes the issue.


I have 20 routers, 17 services and 12 middlewares (all HTTP). Most from docker container labels.

### What version of Traefik are you using?

3.0.3

### What is your environment & configuration?

traefik.yml

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Thank you all for your input and for sharing your experiences regarding the memory leak. After investigating on my end, I haven't been able to reproduce the memory leak issue with any compression method, including br and zstd. While it's true that compression does use additional memory, in my tests, memory usage returns to normal levels once traffic decreases.

However, there is one notable difference I would like to highlight between Traefik v2 and v3 regarding compression. In v2, only gzip was supported, whereas in v3, we added support for Brotli (br) and Zstandard (zstd). These newer compression algorithms are more memory-intensive compared to gzip. From my tests, I've observed that gzip consumes around 200MB, whereas Brotli and Zstandard can go up to 900MB.

To address this, a PR has been merged that introduces the ability to select which compression algorithms you want to enable. This feature will be available in the next minor release, which is expected to be released very soon.

In the meantime, to further investigate this potential memory leak, could someone provide a complete reproducible case? This would greatly help us narrow down the issue. Ideally, here's what we would need:

 - Full Traefik configuration (including any middleware or specific settings related to compression).
 - Details about the backends you're using (e.g., type of services, behavior under load).
 - Traffic generation tool you're using to simulate load (e.g., curl, wrk, or other testing frameworks) and the exact parameters used during the tests.
 - If possible, any metrics or logs showing memory usage over time.

The more detailed the scenario, the quicker we can identify and resolve the issue.

comments.body:
After running some tests, I can confirm that the memory usage is linked to the compression algorithms.

Here are the results I observed:

Without compression: Memory usage is around 2-3 MB.
With Gzip enabled: Memory usage goes up to 20-30 MB.
With Zstandard (Zstd) enabled: Memory usage is between 60-80 MB.
With Brotli enabled: Memory usage increases to 350-500 MB.
The new compression methods introduced in Traefik 3.x seem to require more memory compared to Gzip or no compression. Starting from version 3.2, there is a new feature that allows excluding certain compressions, which can help reduce memory usage.
https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.2/middlewares/http/compress/#encodings

I suggest testing with the 3.2 RC version, as the final release should arrive soon.
